name: Canals (Stormwind City)
summary: The Canals are a network of stone-lined waterways weaving through Stormwind City, separating its distinct districts. They serve as quiet thoroughfares for pedestrians and anglers, while quietly harboring hidden hazards and the entrance to the city's prison.

sections.title: Arteries of the Capital
sections.body: The Canals link and define the districts of Stormwind, dividing the bustling markets of the Trade District from the aged alleys of Old Town, the cathedral gardens, and the Dwarven District. Stone bridges, archways, and waterside walkways frame quiet establishments like the Gallina Winery, tailor shops, and quiet residential homes. In addition to serving local merchants and recreational fishermen, the waterways conceal the fortified entrance to the Stockade, where Stormwind's most dangerous criminals and rebels are held beneath street level.

sections.title: A Gruesome History and Lurking Shadows
sections.body: The placid surface of the waterways belies a violent past. When the Horde sacked Stormwind during the First War, the city was left in ruins, and the canals were restored only as the capital was rebuilt after the Second War. Today, while cleaned and restored, the depths retain an air of mystery, fueled by city rumors of a massive albino crocolisk prowling beneath the docks.

faq.q: What happened to the canals during the First War?
faq.answer: When the Orcish Horde conquered and sacked Stormwind in the First War, the city and its waterways were left in ruins. The canals were restored along with the rest of the capital when Stormwind was rebuilt after the Second War.

faq.q: Is there really a monster in the Stormwind canals?
faq.answer: No one can say for certain. Persistent urban legends tell of a massive white crocolisk lurking in the waterways. City guards and residents often dismiss it as tavern gossip, but the reports keep coming, and adventurers are warned not to fall in.

faq.q: Where is the entrance to the Stockade located?
faq.answer: The Stockade entrance is located along the northernmost stretch of the canal surrounding the Mage Quarter, guarded heavily by the Stormwind City Guard.

faq.q: Can players swim through the canals to travel around Stormwind?
faq.answer: Swimming the canals is entirely possible, though getting back out onto the street requires finding stone stairs or docks spaced along the waterside paths.

angles.text: The quiet canal banks provide convenient spots for aspiring chefs to practice fishing for fresh catches without ever leaving the safety of the capital's walls.
The canals stand as a testament to the rebuilding of the capital, restored from the ruins of the First War into a functional, picturesque city.
